name: cadence
description: A free, private, end-to-end encrypted period tracker for every age.
author: Suhani Tiwari

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c gray,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
